_comment: PURPOSE: lists the client's packages and scripts. JSON cannot hold comments, so the notes live in this array.
HOW: Don't write this file by hand. In client/, run `npm create vite@latest . -- --template react` (JavaScript, not TypeScript). Vite then replaces this file with a real one.
PACKAGES (dependencies): react, react-dom (both added by Vite), react-router-dom (add with `npm install react-router-dom`).
DEV PACKAGES (devDependencies): vite, @vitejs/plugin-react (both added by Vite).
DO NOT ADD: axios (we use fetch) or any CSS framework (we use plain CSS in src/index.css).
SCRIPTS: "dev": "vite" starts the dev server on http://localhost:5173. "build": "vite build". "preview": "vite preview".
SECURITY: the Gemini API key never goes in the client. The browser only talks to our server through /api.
TALKS TO: vite.config.js (the dev server settings), src/main.jsx (the app's entry file).
